title: IELTS Mock Test 2026 January Writing Practice Test 1
rules: Stay in full-screen mode until you submit the exam.

tasks.title: Task 1
tasks.heading: Writing Task 1
tasks.summary: Complete Task 1 in at least 150 words.
promptParagraphs: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. The graph below shows the percentage of money spent on advertising in five types of media in France from 2010 and projected spending to 2040.
Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
You should write at least 150 words.

tasks.title: Task 2
tasks.heading: Writing Task 2
tasks.summary: Complete Task 2 in at least 250 words.
promptParagraphs: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Some people think all lawbreakers should be sent to prison, while others think there are better alternatives for those whose crimes are minor, such as making them do work for the local community. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
You should write at least 250 words.
